inputs.original_text: Pinarayi Vijayan’s forceful denial of the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations around the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project sounds less like reassurance and more like an attempt to shut down scrutiny. When powerful officials dismiss a politically charged accusation so emphatically, I’d ask whose interests the project serves—and why the response is focused on rejecting the charge rather than making the arrangement transparent.
inputs.modified_text: That forceful denial over the Rs 700 crore allegations tied to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project looks like damage control, not reassurance. They want the accusation dismissed before anyone follows the money or asks who stands to benefit. When the response is so focused on shutting down scrutiny instead of opening up the arrangement, that’s reason to suspect the project is serving interests they don’t want exposed.
